method: Pulled directly from GSC's own Links report (search-console/links) for the miloosh.com property -- first-party, authoritative data, not a third-party backlink-crawler estimate.

externalLinks.note: GSC's own report shows the homepage as the only page with any recorded external link at all -- no /software/*, /compare/*, or /best-* page has a single recorded external inbound link.

topLinkingSites.assessment: Almost certainly NOT a genuine editorial endorsement -- vercel.app is Vercel's own preview/deployment subdomain space, and 93 of the 100 total external links (93%) come from this single domain. This strongly suggests infrastructure/preview-deployment self-links rather than real third-party citations.
Real external domain, not previously documented in this engagement's offsite ledger -- worth the user's own investigation.

anchorTextAssessment: All generic, navigational, or branded anchors -- consistent with directory-listing-style links (which typically just use the site name as anchor text) rather than topical editorial citations (e.g. 'best CRM alternatives' or 'software comparison tool').
keyFinding: Excluding the likely-infrastructure vercel.app links, Miloosh has approximately 6 real external links total, from 4 distinct real domains, ALL pointing to the homepage, none pointing to any individual content page. This is not 'low authority' -- it is close to zero measurable external authority at the individual-page level, for every single page on the site. This is hard, first-party, quantified confirmation of the Domain/Entity Trust Gap hypothesis (Lane D), directly consistent with the zero-branded-demand finding (brand-demand.json) and HubSpot's real rejection reason ('Low reach').
reddit_offsite_verification_bonus: This data does not confirm or refute the Antigravity ledger's OTHER 'EXECUTED_LIVE' claim (a Reddit comment) -- Reddit links would not necessarily appear in GSC's Links report the same way a followed directory link does, and no reddit.com domain appears in this list regardless. That claim remains unverified.
